summary: Add an explicit work-scope retirement proof and a native escaped-descendant control.

replay.detail: No replay or derived-state changes; this adds an unused runtime API and its controls.

schema.detail: No database or persisted ledger format changes; no storage-version change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or member coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: The additive Rust runtime API does not change the CLI, SDK pin or current callers. Complete ending evidence requires a Linux user manager and readable cgroup v2 state; detached modes return no proof.

downtime.detail: No new startup or runtime path is activated by this prerequisite; no additional interruption is expected.

manual.detail: No existing installation action. The ignored real-manager control must be selected explicitly by the separately reviewed isolation-VM change; a skip is not evidence.

recovery.detail: No migration or new production caller is introduced; existing recovery and rollback rules are unchanged.
